about: Raymond J. Dearie attended law school and graduated from The University of Montana School of Law in 1997. Raymond Dearie began practicing law in 1998.

Raymond Dearie is an attorney at Dearie Law Group, PS, helping people with Personal Injury - General: Plaintiff issues. Dearie Law Group, PS has an office in Seattle, Washington, serving the local community.

Raymond Dearie was selected to Super Lawyers for 2010 - 2026. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.
